outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a plot showing averages.
Panel B is histological micrograph (H&E staining), not a plot.

Panel C contains a box plot of total polyp number per mouse across genotypes (n=8-18 per genotype) with no individual data points overlaid, and a 3D bar chart of polyp number by diameter category also without individual data points shown. Box plots technically don't require points, but the bar chart component (polyp number per mouse per diameter bin, presumably a mean) does require individual data points and none are shown.
Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (line plot), which is exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel E includes a blot and a bar graph quantifying GTP-bound Rac1 and Cdc42 (relative to total), presented as bars with error bars but without individual data points overlaid.
Panel F is immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a plot.

Panel G includes a blot/zymogram and a bar graph (relative expression of Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) with error bars but no individual data points shown; the right-side blot for polyp diameter series is a blot with no associated plot.
